target.statement: MANIQA achieves PLCC 0.983 on the LIVE dataset, outperforming all compared NR-IQA methods.
target.table_ref: Table 1, LIVE PLCC column, MANIQA row

compute.basis: Training MANIQA on LIVE requires fine-tuning a ViT-B/8 model for 50 epochs with 5 random splits, which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours; a GPU is necessary.

blockers: Requires GPU for training (paper uses RTX 3090)
Training involves 5 random splits and 50 epochs, which is time-consuming
ViT-B/8 pretrained weights need to be downloaded
title: MANIQA: Multi-dimension Attention Network for No-Reference Image Quality Assessment
